## Steps to reproduce

Include the command or UI action, expected input type, and a minimal reproducible
example. For a benchmark, include its profile, candidate/configuration, protocol
version, and failure phase. State whether the result is smoke or dataset-backed.

## Environment

Include OS, Python version, CPU/CUDA device, relevant lock versions, and server
image identity when applicable. Share safe error text and artifact references;
omit credentials, private source material, and unnecessary model/data binaries.
